newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trelleborg seeks Canada unit listing.
newsitem.headline: Trelleborg seeks Canada unit listing.

text.p: Swedish mining and minerals concern Trelleborg said it had applied to Canadian regulatory authorities to list its mining unit Boliden Ltd in Canada.
Trelleborg said in a statement it would retain between 45 and 49 percent of Boliden after the listing.

Trelleborg also named a new board for Boliden. Stelco Chairman Fred Telmer will be board chairman and the board will include Falconbridge Chairman Alex Balogh and former Cominco head of finance Robert Stone. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
